President Trump signed an executive order directing U.S. federal agencies to rename Lake Ontario as Lake America, with the change already reflected on Google Maps for U.S. users and Canada yet to formally respond.

Full Narration

President Trump signed an executive order renaming Lake Ontario to Lake America on Thursday, Snopes confirmed. The name change took effect on Google Maps for U.S. users immediately after the order was signed. Lake Ontario borders both the United States and Canada, making the unilateral federal renaming an immediate point of friction with Ottawa. Canada has not recognized the new name. The order directs U.S. federal agencies to use 'Lake America' in all official documentation and mapping. The test is whether the name appears in U.S. federal charts, navigation systems, and agency communications before Canada formally responds.

Full Narration

At least 356 people are confirmed dead and nearly 2,500 are missing after flash floods swept through Nepal and Tibet this week. The death toll has climbed steadily as rescue teams reach more remote valleys. The floods followed heavy monsoon rains across the Himalayan region, cutting off roads and isolating communities. Recovery teams have been working under difficult conditions, with access routes destroyed in multiple districts. The question is whether the missing figure stabilizes or continues to rise as search operations expand into harder-to-reach areas.

Full Narration

Dolly Parton died at age 80 following a brief battle with cancer. Her Grand Ole Opry debut came at age 13, and over 6 decades she built a body of work that extended well beyond music. She funded research that contributed to a lifesaving vaccine used around the world. Her Imagination Library program donated hundreds of millions of books to children globally. The program has reached children in multiple countries and continues operating. Parton's philanthropy ran in parallel with her recording career for decades, and both leave lasting institutional legacies.
